name: Mania na Onna
source:
Heroine is a stalker girl. She bumps into a salary-man on the street and stuffs his house with spy tech to eavesdrop and and peep on him. And she's not going to give in to his lover girl that easily.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-october-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
女主角是一名跟踪狂。她在街上撞见一名上班族，随后在对方家中布满监视设备，窃听并偷窥他。她可不会轻易向他的恋人认输。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-october-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
